response: Unroll the cylinder into a flat rectangle. The rectangle has width equal to the circumference of the rod, 4 cm, and height equal to the length of the rod, 12 cm. The string winds around 4 times, so it goes across the rectangle as 4 straight segments, each going the full 4 cm horizontally while rising a vertical distance of 12 ÷ 4 = 3 cm. Each segment is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs 4 cm and 3 cm, so each segment has length √(4² + 3²) = √(16 + 9) = √25 = 5 cm. Total length of the string = 4 × 5 cm = 20 cm.
